verdict.rationale: Riveter's core enrichment model processes many rows of input data at once, generating rows from a spec and filling AI-derived columns in bulk (docs-1, docs-2), with concrete bulk examples like finding every dental practice in a city and enumerating all dentists in one request (docs-16), and SDK/pagination support for listing runs (docs-22). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scale limits and no explicit documentation of per-run item count ceilings or performance benchmarks.
